harness.coder_prompt: You are an expert Rust engineer. Write one complete, self-contained Rust source file that satisfies the task, using only the standard library. Respond with the whole file in a single ```rust fenced code block and nothing else. Include an empty `fn main() {}` (the file is compiled as a program).
lessons: Validate the complete input structure and grammar before interpreting values or returning errors; honor specified global validation precedence.
Validate inputs before arithmetic, and prove every intermediate fits across all accepted execution paths; use checked operations when needed.
Check every explicit interface, file, and source constraint, including required omissions and forbidden constructs, before submitting.
Implement each algorithm’s complete selection and tie-breaking rule at every step.
After each event that makes a resource available, process all eligible queued work before advancing time; preserve cumulative budgets across interruptions and requeues.
Preserve explicit dimensions and represent control state separately from valid data values.
When serializing collections, emit delimiters only between actual elements.
Detect numeric overflow during digit accumulation instead of relying on a wider type to hold an unbounded token.
